errors.text_span: Die y-Achse ist linear skaliert und reicht von 0 bis 400, wobei die Werte in Milliarden US-Dollar angegeben werden
errors.evidence: The y-axis is actually two separate axes: the left axis for Exporte and Importe ranging from 0 to 400, and the right axis for Saldo ranging from -200 to 400.
The description does not mention the two different y-axes, one on the left and one on the right, which are crucial for understanding the chart.

errors.text_span: und bleibt bis Ende 2023 relativ stabil etwa bei 150 Milliarden US-Dollar
errors.evidence: The violet line representing exports does not appear to stabilize at 150 billion US dollars but fluctuates around 150-175.
